# Agentic

> Experimental Agentic Action Profile 0.1: tracking, verifying, and recovering agent actions.

This is a draft specification and project-authored reference implementation. No independent adoption is claimed. The hosted platform provides synthetic HTTP/PostgreSQL recovery tests, public URL auditing, MCP tools, A2A testing tasks and autonomous Agent Auth. The separate local reference service remains loopback-only. A profile is untrusted data and never grants authorization.
- [Hosted platform](https://ruagentic.org/platform/): Private synthetic tests and saved reports.
- [Connect an agent](https://ruagentic.org/connect/): MCP, WebMCP, A2A and Agent Auth setup.

## Start here
- [Get started](https://ruagentic.org/docs/GETTING-STARTED.md): Generate files, install tools, and integrate a service.
- [Quick start](https://ruagentic.org/docs/QUICKSTART.md): Install and run a real interrupted HTTP action.
- [Documentation](https://ruagentic.org/docs/index.md): Guides and reference index.
- [FAQ](https://ruagentic.org/docs/FAQ.md): Requirements, limitations, and draft status.
- [Generator](https://ruagentic.org/docs/GENERATOR.md): Browser and command-line profile creation.

## Specification
- [agentic.txt companion](https://ruagentic.org/docs/AGENTIC-TXT.md): Generated action index and JSON authority.
- [Live action index](https://ruagentic.org/agentic.txt): Index for the hosted synthetic ticket service.
- [Live JSON profile](https://ruagentic.org/agentic.json): Authoritative profile for that synthetic service.
- [Normative draft](https://ruagentic.org/docs/SPEC.md): Requirements and supported OpenAPI binding.
- [Profile schema](https://ruagentic.org/schemas/agentic-0.1.schema.json): Versioned JSON Schema.
- [Receipt schema](https://ruagentic.org/schemas/receipt-0.1.schema.json): Outcome observation format.
- [Examples](https://ruagentic.org/docs/EXAMPLES.md): Complete profile, OpenAPI, and illustrative receipt.
- [Integration guide](https://ruagentic.org/docs/INTEGRATIONS.md): Host and service responsibilities.
- [Protocol setup](https://ruagentic.org/docs/PROTOCOLS.md): MCP tools, conditional WebMCP, and A2A / Agent Auth discovery status.

## Testing and contributions
- [Compatibility runner](https://ruagentic.org/docs/COMPATIBILITY.md): Exercise independently written clients.

- [Repository](https://github.com/sam1siam/agentic): Source and public coordination.
